title: Logical Splunk MCP Adapter Contract
description: Agent-facing logical operations for Splunk-backed logs, Events and normalized Kubernetes object snapshots. Names must be mapped to actual connected MCP server tools during integration.

tools.name: query_splunk_dossier
tools.description: Bounded cluster-scoped search over logs, Events and normalized Kubernetes object snapshots. Logical adapter operation; map to the connected server tool at deployment.

node_name.description: Optional target draining node name (e.g. worker-01.prod.rhocp)

time_window.description: Time range window for log and metric retrieval

max_records.description: Hard upper limit on records returned

tools.name: k8s_live_inventory_lookup
tools.description: Logical KV Store inventory operation. Supports exact object lookup or bounded list lookup; this is not a Kubernetes API call.

namespace.description: Optional namespace filter. Omit for cluster-scoped resources.

name.description: Optional exact resource name. Required only when lookup_mode=exact.

lookup_mode.description: Exact name lookup or bounded list lookup.

label_selector.description: Optional selector filter, only supported when labels are indexed by the collector.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by the previous list response.

parameters.description: For lookup_mode=exact, name is required. For lookup_mode=list, name must be omitted and limit/cursor bound the result. Unsupported kinds return status=unsupported, not an empty result.

tools.name: query_broad_anomaly_dossier
tools.description: Track B only: bounded broad anomaly search over Splunk logs, Events and object snapshots. Prometheus metrics are queried through the separate Prometheus adapter.

node_name.description: Target node experiencing drain stall or rollout block

max_records.description: Hard upper cap on anomaly records
